letter: If I could go back to any of these places, I’d want to go with you. The places are worth remembering because you’re the person I got to share them with.
This little map will keep growing. I’m glad I get to find out what goes on it next with you.

places.title: Where we first met
places.story: We met at Union College in September 2007 and became friends. We spent a lot of time together over the next few years.

places.title: Graduation day
places.story: We graduated from Union College together in 2010. We were still friends then.

places.title: Who wants to visit over break?
places.story: I put a question on Facebook asking who wanted to visit me over break. Savannah drove from Lincoln to visit me in Owosso.

places.title: North Carolina to Florida to Michigan
places.story: Savannah flew to North Carolina. We drove from Hendersonville to Orlando, then all the way up to Michigan, where she flew out.

places.title: Our first date
places.story: I visited Savannah in Lincoln in April 2011, and that’s when we started dating. For our first date, we went to the Nebraska State Capitol and got ice cream downtown.

places.title: One year of dating
places.place: Grove Park Inn · Asheville, North Carolina
places.story: We celebrated one year of dating at the Grove Park Inn in Asheville.

places.title: She said yes at Alleia
places.story: I got down on one knee at Alleia, asked Savannah to marry me, and she said yes. We were both a little sad that nobody noticed.
places.note: We still joke about the free dessert we never got.

places.title: Engagement photos in Asheville
places.story: We took engagement photos on the Biltmore grounds and in downtown Asheville.

places.title: Our wedding day
places.story: We got married in Middletown and held our reception at Pacific Union College.

places.title: Four breakfasts in Auckland
places.story: We flew into Auckland so early that we ended up getting breakfast something like four times.

places.title: A few nights in Rotorua
places.story: We drove from Auckland to Rotorua and spent four or five nights there on our honeymoon.

places.title: Our second wedding
places.story: We flew from New Zealand to Sydney for a second wedding with Savannah’s Australian family. I was there for 48 hours before flying back, and Savannah stayed longer.

places.title: Our first home together
places.story: We lived in a basement in Dunwoody from November 2013 to June 2015, and we both worked at Atlanta North School.
places.note: Our one request for the basement: more light!

places.title: The 2014 Caribbean cruise
places.story: Our cruise included the Dominican Republic, Turks and Caicos, Half Moon Beach, Aruba, Bonaire, and Curaçao.

places.title: The Shakopee townhouse
places.story: We moved to a townhouse in Shakopee and lived there for a year.

places.title: We moved to Brooklyn Park
places.story: After our year in Shakopee, we moved to Brooklyn Park.

places.title: We were expecting Violet
places.story: In the fall of 2017, we found out we were expecting Violet.

places.title: Violet arrived
places.story: Violet was born on June 1, 2018.

places.title: We were expecting Max and Ellie
places.story: In the fall of 2021, we found out we were expecting Max and Ellie.

places.title: Max and Ellie arrived
places.story: Max and Ellie were born on June 22, 2022.

places.title: One night away
places.story: For dates and anniversaries, we love getting away for one night at a bed-and-breakfast or a downtown hotel.

places.title: Our takeout favorites
places.story: We love Thai takeout and Red Robin delivery.

places.title: Explore Europe together
places.story: We’d love to take a trip to Europe together.

places.title: Another Caribbean cruise
places.story: We’d love another Caribbean cruise, with the family or just the two of us.

places.title: Head out to Yellowstone
places.story: We’d like to explore the Yellowstone area. This one feels the most likely to happen.

places.title: Savannah’s Vietnam mission trip
places.story: Savannah hopes to go to Vietnam on a mission trip in 2027.
